summary: Verify opener detachment before document writes. On failure, attempt to close the blank popup, show a generic retry notice, and return false so both callers skip scheduled printing.

source_verification.before_source_supported_conditional_risk: Old catch ignores failed opener assignment and immediately writes a printable document while the parent remains attached. Sanitized saved content may include http(s) links. No real exposure or external exploit is demonstrated.
source_verification.behavioral_failure_proven: For both actual callers, a real popup with only opener setter failure/ignored assignment substituted receives one real document.write and one scheduled OS-print call on old source. Six failures include close-cleanup failure controls.

assertions: no write or scheduled print unless opener is null
failed popup close attempted; close failure cannot bypass no-write/no-print guard
normal real popup detaches opener, renders content, schedules one print
writing and analysis references, portfolio/roster/pending bytes retained
native_regression.substitutions: Real Window/document/render/callers retained. Native window.open used for every non-blocked case. Only opener property failure, close failure and OS print boundaries replaced. Context routes abort all non-local requests.

behavior_preserved: Successful current/saved document construction, actual opener detachment, focus/fit/700ms scheduling, blocked-popup messages and rendering preserved. Document open/write/close errors still propagate as before; no broad document-error swallowing. No writes to persisted user state. Only failed isolation stops the operation.

scanner_expectation.primary_error_handling: Original empty isolation catch is replaced by an explicit failure state and recoverable no-write path; coordinator must confirm scanner refresh.
scanner_expectation.new_optional_cleanup_catch: Empty close catch is intentional best-effort cleanup after required isolation already failed. Forced-close-error cases for both callers verify writing/print remain blocked and notice still appears. Retain this guard if flagged.
scanner_expectation.shape: Helper CCN4,18 nonblank lines,nesting2; each caller adds one early return. Native matrix test shape is functional failure/success coverage, not a production-policy change.

not_checked: Live external services, real attack or OS print dialog
risk: If popup closure itself is denied, an empty popup can remain open with its original opener. No printable content is written and no print scheduled; user gets a retry notice. Real credential exposure was not observed.
intermediate_validation: Initial fix passed the same three suites, then was flattened before final validation to avoid nested recovery catches. Final authoritative source/receipts are after.json and after-final.
